title: A 64-year-old crawfish restaurant owner runs marketing and a daily ops report with Tencent WorkBuddy
titleZh: 64 岁小龙虾店主用腾讯 WorkBuddy 做营销文案与每日经营日报
summary: Dai Qinghua, 64, has run a crawfish restaurant in Maba town, Xuyi, Jiangsu for 15 years. With his son's help he connected Tencent WorkBuddy to the restaurant's WeChat Work: it now writes WeChat Moments marketing copy, suggests new crawfish flavours, generates a daily store-manager operations report, and syncs live Jiangsu crawfish wholesale prices.
summaryZh: 64 岁的戴庆华在江苏盱眙马坝镇经营龙虾馆 15 年。在儿子的帮助下，他把腾讯 WorkBuddy 接入龙虾馆的企业微信：由 AI 负责撰写朋友圈营销文案、提供龙虾新口味研发建议、每日自动生成「店长经营日报」，并实时同步江苏小龙虾批发行情。
background: A small restaurant owner has no marketing or analyst function. The work that gets done is the work that fits between cooking and serving — which is why an assistant embedded in a tool he already uses matters more than a standalone app.
backgroundZh: 小餐饮店主没有市场部也没有分析师。能被完成的，只有夹在备菜与上菜之间能做完的事——这也是「嵌在他本来就在用的工具里」比独立 App 更重要的原因。

keyFact: As reported in March 2026, a 64-year-old crawfish restaurant owner in Xuyi, Jiangsu, uses Tencent WorkBuddy connected to WeChat Work to write marketing copy, generate a daily operations report and sync live wholesale prices.
keyFactZh: 据 2026 年 3 月报道，江苏盱眙一位 64 岁小龙虾店主把腾讯 WorkBuddy 接入企业微信，用于撰写营销文案、生成每日经营日报并同步实时批发行情。
